content.comment_body: I have [product_name] installed on an older computer but it does not show up in the license manager. I want to move it to a new computer and retire the old one. I installed the software, but I only get the demo version. Is there any way to transfer the license as needed? I read online that this might only allow for a single installation.
This question was posted twice. You can find the answer here: [url]
This thread was closed as the question was already published elsewhere. The other post about license transfer is listed within the relevant conference topic. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters issues transferring their [product_name] license from an old computer to a new one, as the license is not detected by the license manager. This hinders activation and leads to confusion about the licensing process and its limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple and hassle-free process for transferring a single-use license for [product_name] between devices, with recognition by the license manager and without technical complications.
